readerCopy.body: A last-minute schedule change triggers a sharp conflict over who actually gets to make the call. One person reacts instantly, but the manager, parent, or venue owner responds by enforcing strict policy and shutting down further discussion. The Moon makes the initial anger impossible to hide, while Pluto uses rank, contract, or financial leverage to squash the pushback. Friction accumulates under the square until the disagreement becomes a direct challenge to the existing power structure. The original decision may hold, but everyone involved leaves knowing how quickly goodwill evaporates the moment authority feels questioned.
